observations: CSharp Windows uses Unicode operating-system environment query with explicit empty/missing behavior; SLG uses CRT _wgetenv. CSharp Linux and SLG use borrowed getenv.
Source API difference is not yet an observed compiler defect. Run unchanged original84 under identical process-local Unicode/empty/missing environment before deciding whether an edit is necessary.

Python3.11 os.environ assignment of empty removes Windows OS entry; direct SetEnvironmentVariableW establishes original empty entry without changing global/user environment. m11153 is setup mismatch, not compiler defect.
decisions: Keep original84 source, stdout and required LLVM unchanged. CSharp current runtime and exact LLVM are already correct; match Unicode OS API and allocation/encoding/error decisions in SLG.

Windows emitEnvironment uses GetEnvironmentVariableW with SetLastError/GetLastError for missing/empty distinction and sized stable value buffer; no CRT environment view. Use existing runtime-owned UTF8 allocation list and malloc/free mapping.
Emit WinAPI declarations exactly once across environment,directory,owned-file,process-capture,stdin and socket-completion capability combinations; Linux borrowed getenv remains unchanged.
